findings.title: retryCount delete branch is not scoped to SMS reminders
findings.body: The new OR branch in `prisma.workflowReminder.deleteMany` matches any WorkflowReminder with `retryCount > 1` regardless of `method`. Since this SMS cron runs globally, it will delete EMAIL and WHATSAPP workflow reminders as soon as some other code path increments their retryCount (and any future retry logic added for those methods), silently dropping pending reminders. The branch should include `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS`.

findings.title: Retry count not incremented when message/sendTo is missing
findings.body: If `message` is empty or `sendTo` is null, the reminder is neither scheduled nor its retryCount incremented, so it will be re-picked by every cron run until its scheduledDate passes — exactly the infinite-rescheduling problem this PR intends to fix (e.g. missing smsReminderNumber). Consider incrementing retryCount (or marking the reminder) in this case too.

findings.title: deleteMany on retryCount has no supporting index
findings.body: The new delete condition filters on `retryCount` alone (OR branch), which cannot use the existing `[method, scheduled, scheduledDate]` index and will force a full table scan of WorkflowReminder on every cron invocation. Scoping the condition to method/scheduled or adding an appropriate composite index would avoid this.
